summary: A free one-touch arcade game. The core game is playable fully offline. We operate no game servers that store personal data. All personal-data processing is done by named third parties (Google, Apple, a TURN relay provider) for ads, optional leaderboards, optional online 1v1, and Android-only cloud save. In an online 1v1, your display name and selected skin go directly to your opponent's device.

data_collected.name: Advertising ID / IDFA
data_collected.notes: On iOS, tracking use requires opt-in through Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt. Ads still show if tracking is denied; they are simply not personalized.

data_collected.name: Play Games player ID, gamer profile, submitted scores, the skin of a best score
data_collected.notes: Only if you choose to sign in. Optional; the game is fully playable without it. From version 2.4.9 a new best score is submitted with the id of the skin it was set with, and other players see that skin next to your score on the leaderboard. Other local progress, such as stars and owned skins, is not sent to leaderboards.

data_collected.name: Game Center player ID, display name, submitted scores
data_collected.notes: Only if you choose to sign in. Optional. Leaderboards only — iOS progress is not backed up to the cloud, and the skin of a best score is not sent to Game Center.

data_collected.name: Crash data, performance data, other diagnostics
data_collected.processor: Google Play Console (Android) / Apple App Store Connect (iOS)
data_collected.notes: Anonymous. Device model, OS version and stack traces. Cannot be used to identify you.

data_collected.name: Public IP address and ICE candidate data
data_collected.processor: Google STUN, a TURN relay provider, Google Firebase (handshake only)
data_collected.notes: Only when you start or join an online 1v1 match. To coordinate the handshake, Firebase holds the room's connection details, which are deleted once the match connects, and an anonymous account created for that online session (see online_account_id). No score or purchase data is involved.

data_collected.name: Anonymous online account ID
data_collected.notes: Only when you start or join an online 1v1 match. Firebase Authentication creates a random account ID for that online session so the handshake can tell the two players apart. It carries no name, email, Play Games or Game Center account, or advertising ID, and it is never used for tracking; because it is an account ID, it is declared as linked to you. From version 2.1.37 the app deletes it when you leave the online session; if it cannot (for example, the app was closed or offline), it retries at a later launch and gives up after 30 days, or sooner if several such accounts are waiting, and an account it gives up on can stay in our Firebase project. Until then a small record of that account stays on your device only.

data_collected.name: Display name and selected skin, shown to your online opponent
data_collected.processor: None: sent directly to your opponent's device
data_collected.notes: From version 2.4.9, once when an online 1v1 connects. Your Play Games or Game Center display name, if you are signed in, and the id of your selected skin go over the encrypted connection between the two devices, so your opponent sees them for that online session. A TURN relay, if used, cannot read them. They never reach us and are not sent to Firebase. If you are not signed in, your opponent sees PLAYER; your skin is still sent. No store privacy label declares this, because only you and your opponent can read it and it is not stored.

data_collected.name: Game progress (best scores and the skin each was set with, owned skins, star balance, settings)
data_collected.notes: Android only, and only if signed in to Google Play Games. Not available on iOS in this version; iOS progress is stored only on the device.

data_not_collected: names (your Play Games or Game Center display name is handled only as described in play_games_profile, game_center_profile and online_opponent_profile)
Apple ID or Game Center credentials

permission_prompts.when: at the player's first run ending or first opt-in ad — never during first launch
permission_prompts.effect_if_denied: The app is fully functional. Ads still show but are not personalized.

third_party_services.name: Google Play In-App Review
third_party_services.role: Android only: may show Google Play's own rating dialog; your rating goes to Google Play, and we never see who rated

third_party_services.name: Google Play In-App Updates
third_party_services.role: Android only: lets Google Play offer an app update

third_party_services.name: Google Firebase
third_party_services.role: WebRTC handshake for online 1v1 only, with an anonymous account for that online session

third_party_services.name: TURN relay provider
third_party_services.role: relays online 1v1 traffic when a direct connection is not possible

opt_out.how: Settings → Google → Ads — reset or delete the Advertising ID
Do not sign in to Game Center or Google Play Games. The game is fully playable without it.
Stay signed out of Google Play Games or Game Center, and your opponent sees PLAYER, or do not play online. There is no in-game setting for this.
Do not start an online 1v1 match. The rest of the game is unaffected.

retention_and_deletion: We run no servers of our own. The connection details of an online match are deleted once it connects. The anonymous account an online match uses is held in our Firebase project (Google): from version 2.1.37 the app deletes it when you leave the online session; if it cannot (for example, the app was closed or offline), it retries at a later launch and gives up after 30 days, or sooner if several such accounts are waiting, and an account it gives up on can stay in our Firebase project. Until then a small record of that account stays on your device only. Your name and skin in an online match are not stored by the game after that online session and never reach us. Data held by Google or Apple is governed by their policies and can be removed through your Google or Apple account. Deleting the app removes all local game progress on that device.
children: The game is rated 4+ and is not directed at children under the age required by applicable law in your region. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
